data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arelus total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: Arelus
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler of man
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Arelus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Latin word 'arēlus', meaning 'ruler of man'. This name is rooted in the Christian faith and conveys a sense of leadership and authority.

in_greek.name: Arelus
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ruler of man
in_greek.long_meaning: Arelus είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Latin word 'arēlus', meaning 'ruler of man'. This name is rooted in the Christian faith and conveys a sense of leadership and authority.

in_latin.name: Arelus
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ruler of man
in_latin.long_meaning: Arelus est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Latin word 'arēlus', meaning 'ruler of man'. This name is rooted in the Christian faith and conveys a sense of leadership and authority.
